name: Ricardo Gonzalez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly after a career in sports journalism. Initially covering local racing events in Argentina, he quickly became fascinated by the intricate dance between teams, drivers, and the media. Realizing his knack for building relationships and shaping narratives, Ricardo transitioned into a PR role, first with a national rally team and then with Formula E. His ability to translate complex technical information into engaging stories has earned him respect within the paddock.

Ricardo believes in proactive communication and building trust with the media. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his creative approach to handling challenging situations. He is meticulous about detail, ensuring accuracy and consistent messaging. What sets him apart is his deep understanding of Argentine motorsport culture and the ability to connect with Latin American fans, expanding the team's reach into a valuable market.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium height with a friendly, approachable face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with story ideas.
Insists on drinking mate every afternoon, regardless of location.
Has a habit of using motorsport analogies in everyday conversations.
